thread.title: Apple slips after analysts slash iPhone sales forecasts (AAPL)

author: nally
title: Apple slips after analysts slash iPhone sales forecasts (AAPL)
text: in General Analysts at Goldman Sachs and RBC Capital Markets have separately slashed their iPhone sales estimates, citing sluggish demand for the smartphones.The analysts expect Apple to release its latest wave of iPhones in September, meaning the company could soon start curbing its inventory to make way for new products. Firms - Price - Targets - Earnings - Forecasts Both firms reduced their price targets and earnings forecasts.You can watch Apple's stock move in real time here. Forecasts - Apple - IPhone - Sales - Ax Forecasts for Apple's iPhone sales have gotten the ax. After the smartphone pioneer experienced sluggish sales growth in its most recent quarter, Wall Street analysts believe the trend is likely to continue, calling it the end of an era for the iPhone. Analysts - Goldman - Sachs - RBC - Capital Analysts at Goldman Sachs and RBC Capital Markets told clients in separate notes on Wednesday that they were slashing their estimates of iPhone units sold on the view that the devices would experience less demand and lower average selling prices in the future.The Goldman Sachs analyst Rod Hall said in a note to clients on Wednesday that the bank would reduce its iPhone sales estimates by 1.7 million units to 53 million units for the quarter ending in March and its estimates for the quarter ending in June by 3.2 million units to 40.3 million units. Moreover, the investment bank has also slashed its iPhone sales forecast for the 2019 fiscal year to 224 million units, down 4% from its initial estimate, and to 223 million units in the 2020 fiscal year, down 1.8% from its previous estimate.
